Case_18006/figure2.jpg.source_caption: Figure 2: Left Eye Fundus and Retinal Exam with Fluorescein (black and white).

description.short_caption: Black-and-white fluorescein angiography of the left eye fundus showing retinal findings.
description.detailed_description: This is a black-and-white fluorescein angiography image of the left eye fundus. The optic disc is centrally located, appearing slightly elevated with irregular borders. Surrounding the optic disc, there is evidence of hyperfluorescence, suggesting leakage or staining. Retinal vessels radiate outward, and the background shows a granular texture. The image is de-identified and appears to focus on pathological changes in the retina.

Case_18006/figure1.jpg.source_caption: Figure 1: Left Eye Fundus and Retinal Exam with Fluorescein (color).

description.short_caption: Fundus photograph of the left eye showing a yellow-white retinal lesion with fluorescein enhancement.
description.detailed_description: This is a color fundus photograph of the left eye, taken with fluorescein imaging. The central retina displays a prominent yellow-white lesion with irregular borders, suggestive of an inflammatory or infectious process. Surrounding retinal tissue appears hyperemic, with visible retinal vasculature. The fluorescein highlights the lesion, indicating active leakage or inflammation.

Case_18006/figure3.jpg.source_caption: Figure 3: CT Chest without contrast. Top arrow: emphysema-like changes; Bottom arrow: Bilateral multifocal nodules measuring 3 to 11 mm.

description.short_caption: CT chest without contrast showing emphysema-like changes and bilateral multifocal nodules.
description.detailed_description: This is a coronal CT image of the chest without contrast. The image demonstrates emphysema-like changes, particularly in the upper lobes, as indicated by the top arrow. The bottom arrow highlights bilateral multifocal nodules, ranging in size from approximately 3 to 11 mm. The lung parenchyma shows areas of hyperlucency consistent with emphysematous changes, and the nodules are scattered throughout both lungs.
visible_findings: emphysema-like changes in the upper lobes
bilateral multifocal nodules measuring 3 to 11 mm

Case_18006/figure4.jpg.source_caption: Figure 4: MRI Brain showing a 5mm ring-enhancing lesion in the right precentral gyrus with surrounding edema.

description.short_caption: MRI brain showing a ring-enhancing lesion in the right precentral gyrus with surrounding edema.
description.detailed_description: This coronal MRI image of the brain demonstrates a 5mm ring-enhancing lesion located in the right precentral gyrus. The lesion is surrounded by hyperintense edema, which is suggestive of an inflammatory or infectious process. The image appears to be taken with contrast enhancement, as evidenced by the ring-enhancing pattern. The surrounding brain parenchyma shows signs of mass effect and edema.
visible_findings: ring-enhancing lesion in the right precentral gyrus
mass effect on adjacent brain tissue
